name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; winter margin 9.5%
summary: NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW, 9.5% winter buffer; no Electricity Margin or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 16 Nov
state: NESO's Winter Outlook forecasts a 5.9 GW operational surplus this winter, a 9.5% buffer over peak demand, similar to last winter (Solar Power Portal, 26 Oct). NESO last issued an Electricity Margin Notice on 6 Oct for an evening peak during low wind (OilPrice). Searches on 16 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal; the cold spell from 17 Nov may raise demand.
for_you: Households are not expected to see supply interruptions. Margin notices are routine operational tools that ask generators for more output; they do not by themselves mean power cuts.
rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas notice in force; winter margin 5.9 GW (9.5%): Normal

sources.title: Solar Power Portal — GB to have 9.5% buffer over peak demand this winter, NESO says
OilPrice — Low wind generation prompts another power margin warning in UK

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
